issues.description: The type of the 'price' field in StockIngredient is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement UML and the solution implementation use an int price, but the template StockIngredient declares price as double. This mismatch can confuse students when they implement SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice (the UML specifies an int return) and when summing ingredient prices, potentially causing type/compilation issues or uncertainty about whether to use int or double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the StockIngredient.price type consistent. Preferably change the template implementation to use an int for price (private final int price and getPrice returning int) to match the UML in the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, update the problem statement and solution to use double everywhere (and adjust calculateTotalPrice to return a double) — but ensure all three artifacts use the same type.
